items.title: ShinyHunters聲稱竊得FBI資料中，包含敏感的探員個資與醫療紀錄
items.summary: 駭客組織ShinyHunters聲稱駭入美國聯邦調查局（FBI）一事再有新發現。BBC於9月24日報導，他們檢視駭客提供的外洩資料樣本後，發現其中包含FBI探員的醫療檢查紀錄，涉及血液、尿液檢測結果及醫師註記，包括高膽固醇、血尿及食物過敏等資訊，部分資料並附有探員姓名、地址、電話、徽章號碼、職務及配偶資訊。

items.title: GitHub讓AI代理接手模糊測試，可依覆蓋率自動補測未觸及程式碼
items.summary: GitHub Security Lab開源Fuzzing Taskflow，可將大型語言模型代理與AFL++模糊測試工具串成自動化管線。開發者指定C/C++專案的GitHub儲存庫後，代理會找出適合測試的函式、分析建置方式、產生模糊測試程式並執行AFL++，再依程式覆蓋率修改測試程式或測試輸入，程式崩潰分析與漏洞報告也納入流程。GitHub提醒，漏洞判斷與修補內容仍須人工審查。

items.title: 新加坡電信商Simba遭駭，逾2.3萬名用戶個資外洩
items.summary: 新加坡電信業者Simba於9月25日公告發生資料外洩事件，影響23,549名註冊該公司服務的用戶，外洩資料包括用戶姓名、身分證號碼、出生日期、手機號碼及電子郵件地址，但信用卡與銀行帳戶資料並未受到影響，目前尚無跡象顯示相關資料已被惡意濫用。

items.title: 佛州要求法院限制OpenAI開發新模型，禁止向未成年人提供ChatGPT
items.summary: 美國佛羅里達州檢察長James Uthmeier周一（9/28）向法院聲請暫時禁制令，要求OpenAI開發新AI模型時，必須先取得獨立第三方對其安全防護措施的核准，並停止向佛州未成年人提供ChatGPT。法院尚未裁定此事。

items.title: refactor(infra): deslop package publication policy
items.summary: refactor(infra): deslop package publication policy ## What Problem This Solves Package publication preflight and mutation paths duplicated phase admission and retirement-generation selection. This is a maintainer-requested infrastructure deslop slice. ## User Impact No publication, durability, retention, schema, rollback, or update behavior changes. Existing installed-driver behavior is preserved; the released-driver activation fixture remains part of proof. ## Why This Change Was Made The existing publication owner now evaluates each policy in one private helper. Preflight still checks phase before closure inspection; mutations still inspect closure before phase admission. Both pre-acquisition and fresh-fence checks remain. Production: +27/-40/net -13. Tests: +0/-0/net 0. Docs: +0/-0/net 0. ## Evidence Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01m3ny2aw02btzaz276n6v3pjm` ([allocation run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36531963230)), frozen-lockfile install and pinned base `743c2ceb72e7d1372845ea6f834bb82993fc9e0e`. The publication boundary/durability and activation lifetime/released-driver suites passed all 60 cases in the shared 463-case run (171.78s wall). Independent Codex autoreview through P2 was scoped-clean on the final combined follow-up diff, with dependency source supplied. Formatting, cross-tree retired-symbol checks, and `git diff --check` passed. `node scripts/check-changed.mjs --base 743c2ceb72e7d1372845ea6f834bb82993fc9e0e` passed on the final shared follow-up snapshot, including core tsgo, all 27 selected test type graphs, formatting, type-aware lint, dead exports, and architecture guards. The final policy-boundary replay plus changed gate completed in 24m43.680s on the same Testbox lease. Exact shared owner-test command ```sh pnpm test src/infra/device-auth-store.test.ts src/infra/device-auth-store.worker.test.ts src/infra/device-auth-store.client.test.ts src/infra/http-body.response.test.ts src/agents/tools/pdf-native-providers.test.ts src/agents/minimax-vlm.normalizes-api-key.test.ts src/hooks/gmail-watcher.test.ts src/hooks/gmail-watcher.integration.test.ts src/hooks/gmail-ops.test.ts src/infra/diagnostic-events.test.ts src/infra/package-update-publication-boundary.test.ts src/infra/package-update-publication-durability.test.ts src/infra/package-update-activation-lifetime.test.ts src/infra/package-update-activation-released.test.ts src/infra/exec-approvals-config.test.ts src/infra/exec-approvals-policy.test.ts src/infra/state-migrations.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 ``` The source changes were validated together on one lease and are being published separately by owner. This PR includes only its named owner change. The original lease expired during local preparation; the replacement above used a 90-minute idle allowance. No hosted CI was dispatched or rerun for proof.

items.title: fix: protect live Gateways sharing an update installation (#160663)
items.summary: fix: protect live Gateways sharing an update installation (#160663) * fix(update): refuse publication over live managed consumers * fix(launchd): distinguish native logging metadata from authored environment * fix: preserve staged update failures and uncertain child inputs * fix(update): retire untouched preparation after publication refusal Use the retained publication owner to disarm and retire a known pre-effect refusal, allowing the next update to enter. Preserve recovery evidence on unknown cleanup or a foreign replacement, including both failure causes. Receive the real fence dependency into declaration fixtures without invalidating relocation cache identities, and keep legacy refusal assertions aligned with the all-artifact diagnostic. * fix(update): keep activation journals out of retained runtimes * fix(update): preserve service availability through publication Check known shared consumers before stopping the selected Gateway and retain the publication recheck. Adopt delegated Doctor stops in common finalization, preserve partial-stop failures, and keep uncertain recovery fenced. Update the native-reader fixture and document maintenance restoration. * fix(update): retain live launchd observations across plist moves Keep the native loaded command and PID available for shared-install publication refusal when the discovered plist differs. Selected-service correspondence still requires the exact current definition and grants no control over the other job. Four causal regressions, 252 sibling cases, receiving 24 cases, scoped types/lint and independent review passed. Native synthetic GUI jobs preserved loaded identity across mismatched queries, refused selected correspondence, and retired cleanly. * test(update): load adoption owners in restart outcome fixture Common finalization now calls predecessor adoption. Add that production owner and its legacy-stop predicate to the explicit VM module graph so the existing backup-retirement checks reach their intended paths. Original 9 failures/10 passes become19/19 passes; the exact Vitest wrapper, scoped lint/format and independent review also pass. Existing assertions and deadlines are unchanged.
